BiblicalUsage: Pâchach occurs once: God's people are robbed and spoiled, snared in holes and hid in prison houses, taken as a prey with none to deliver.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this one verse names the cost of forgetting God: a people meant to be a light become a prey, until the LORD delivers them.
